mapper.insert: insert into handoff_context_policies(tenant_id,policy_id,policy_name,policy_type,context_requirement,default_field_decision,attachment_policy,approval_mode,allowed_field_paths_json,allowed_comment_types_json,masking_rules_json,result_sharing_policy,enabled,version,created_at,updated_at) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.policyId},#{value.policyName},#{value.policyType},#{value.contextRequirement},#{value.defaultFieldDecision},#{value.attachmentPolicy},#{value.approvalMode},cast(#{value.allowedFieldPathsJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.allowedCommentTypesJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.maskingRulesJson} as jsonb),#{value.resultSharingPolicy},#{value.enabled},#{value.version},#{value.createdAt},#{value.updatedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,policy_id) do update set policy_name=excluded.policy_name,policy_type=excluded.policy_type,context_requirement=excluded.context_requirement,default_field_decision=excluded.default_field_decision,attachment_policy=excluded.attachment_policy,approval_mode=excluded.approval_mode,allowed_field_paths_json=excluded.allowed_field_paths_json,allowed_comment_types_json=excluded.allowed_comment_types_json,masking_rules_json=excluded.masking_rules_json,result_sharing_policy=excluded.result_sharing_policy,enabled=excluded.enabled,version=excluded.version,updated_at=excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: select * from handoff_context_policies where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and policy_id=#{policyId}
select * from handoff_context_policies where tenant_id=#{tenantId} order by policy_id limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into handoff_context_snapshots( tenant_id,snapshot_id,aggregate_id,schema_version,root_task_id,source_task_id,target_task_id,source_agent_id,target_agent_id,target_domain_id,target_binding_hash, context_policy_id,policy_version,snapshot_version,summary,structured_context_json,allowed_comment_refs_json,attachment_metadata_json,redacted_field_paths_json, omitted_content_reasons_json,sensitivity_level,content_hash,source_observed_at,created_at,created_by_type,created_by_id,expires_at,status,approved_by,approved_at, approval_evidence_hash,supersedes_snapshot_id,correlation_id,release_status,release_evidence_id,released_at,last_release_error_code,reconciliation_classification, next_reconcile_at,reconciliation_count,row_version) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.snapshotId},#{value.aggregateId},#{value.schemaVersion},#{value.rootTaskId},#{value.sourceTaskId},#{value.targetTaskId}, #{value.sourceAgentId},#{value.targetAgentId},#{value.targetDomainId},#{value.targetBindingHash},#{value.contextPolicyId},#{value.policyVersion},#{value.snapshotVersion}, #{value.summary},cast(#{value.structuredContextJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.allowedCommentRefsJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.attachmentMetadataJson} as jsonb), cast(#{value.redactedFieldPathsJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.omittedContentReasonsJson} as jsonb),#{value.sensitivityLevel},#{value.contentHash},#{value.sourceObservedAt}, #{value.createdAt},#{value.createdByType},#{value.createdById},#{value.expiresAt},#{value.status},#{value.approvedBy},#{value.approvedAt},#{value.approvalEvidenceHash}, #{value.supersedesSnapshotId},#{value.correlationId},#{value.releaseStatus},#{value.releaseEvidenceId},#{value.releasedAt},#{value.lastReleaseErrorCode}, #{value.reconciliationClassification},#{value.nextReconcileAt},#{value.reconciliationCount},#{value.rowVersion})
mapper.update: update handoff_context_snapshots set status=#{value.status},approved_by=#{value.approvedBy},approved_at=#{value.approvedAt},approval_evidence_hash=#{value.approvalEvidenceHash}, supersedes_snapshot_id=#{value.supersedesSnapshotId},release_status=#{value.releaseStatus},release_evidence_id=#{value.releaseEvidenceId}, released_at=#{value.releasedAt},last_release_error_code=#{value.lastReleaseErrorCode},reconciliation_classification=#{value.reconciliationClassification}, next_reconcile_at=#{value.nextReconcileAt},reconciliation_count=#{value.reconciliationCount},row_version=row_version+1 where tenant_id=#{value.tenantId} and snapshot_id=#{value.snapshotId} and row_version=#{value.rowVersion}
mapper.select: select * from handoff_context_snapshots where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and snapshot_id=#{snapshotId}

select * from handoff_context_snapshots where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and target_task_id=#{taskId} and status='APPROVED' and (expires_at is null or expires_at>now()) order by snapshot_version desc limit 1
select * from handoff_context_snapshots where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and (source_task_id=#{taskId} or target_task_id=#{taskId}) order by snapshot_version desc limit #{limit}

select * from handoff_context_snapshots where status='APPROVED' and release_status in ('READY','FAILED_RETRYABLE','RELEASING') and (next_reconcile_at is null or next_reconcile_at<=#{now}) order by coalesce(next_reconcile_at,created_at),created_at limit #{limit}
select * from handoff_context_field_decisions where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} order by field_path
select * from handoff_context_approvals where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} order by decided_at limit #{limit}
select * from handoff_release_evidence where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} order by occurred_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into result_context_snapshots(tenant_id,result_snapshot_id,root_task_id,source_task_id,target_task_id,policy_id,snapshot_version,result_summary,shared_evidence_refs_json,masked_output_json,omitted_output_reasons_json,result_content_hash,created_by_agent_id,created_at,status,correlation_id) values(#{value.tenantId},#{value.resultSnapshotId},#{value.rootTaskId},#{value.sourceTaskId},#{value.targetTaskId},#{value.policyId},#{value.snapshotVersion},#{value.resultSummary},cast(#{value.sharedEvidenceRefsJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.maskedOutputJson} as jsonb),cast(#{value.omittedOutputReasonsJson} as jsonb),#{value.resultContentHash},#{value.createdByAgentId},#{value.createdAt},#{value.status},#{value.correlationId})
mapper.select: select * from result_context_snapshots where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and result_snapshot_id=#{resultSnapshotId}
select * from result_context_snapshots where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and (source_task_id=#{taskId} or target_task_id=#{taskId}) order by snapshot_version desc limit #{limit}
select * from agent_context_access_events where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_id=#{taskId} order by accessed_at desc limit #{limit}
